title: Fingerprint evidence record
description: A machine evidence record of kind `fingerprint`, written by `review record` into `<evidence dir>/fingerprint/<decl path>/<s12>.<d12>.json` (D43/F11). Deterministic (no time stamps). Evidence never says that a person checked anything. The id must match the fingerprints and the path, and each text must hash to its fingerprint: `review evidence` checks both (a schema cannot).

kind.description: The evidence kind. Read-back and comparator evidence use their own formats (`reviewkit-readback/0`, `reviewkit-comparator-verdict/0`).

decl_kind.description: The kernel kind of the declaration.

serialisation.description: The canonical serialisation the texts use.

text.description: The canonical statement text (other constants by qualified name).
The digest text (content constants as `name#<digest>`, background constants as `name:<16 hex>`).

block_index.description: Position in its inductive block (0 when alone).

block_size.description: Size of its inductive block (1 when alone).

config.description: The config file the tool ran with.

config_sha256.description: sha256 of the config file's bytes.

decl.description: An absolute Lean declaration id as `Name.toString` prints it (the ids `tracker graph` uses).

fingerprintId.description: Evidence id of a fingerprint record: `fingerprint:<decl>@<s12>.<d12>`, the first 12 hex digits of the statement fingerprint and of the digest.

module.description: A Lean module name, for example `Pkg.Sub.Module`.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 hash: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.
